title: SakiSaki
description: A mod that allows characters to crawl on the ground and emit strange cries.
body:
# SakiSaki

A mod that allows characters to crawl on the ground and emit strange cries.

Salute: https://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/ep1231523

### Feature

After pressing the [X] button, the character will assume a crawling posture. Press it again to cancel.

![Screenshot of Crawling Status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b99a8512e2035065298b5e753232f7b63abeb317.png)

You can also use it while online, and people nearby will hear the sound of you crawling.

![Online Crawling Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31914d78e82fa07a5c6712c78f4cf34e6472c3f8.png)

You can modify Saki-chan's voice.

![Sound Settings Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b6ef3f9c6b036a6acd62e1002080774b1f6814a.png)

This mod is also compatible with YSM.
![YSM Crawling Action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e01f3d048c34bbbce97fbe2dcf125d1e4dd9286.png)
